---
title: "References and aliasing"
---

*Two names for one object, and why changing one changes the other.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
Builds on lists and dictionaries to show that assigning one variable to another does not copy the contents, so a change made through one name is visible through the other. Uses the codelens widget to draw the objects and the references on the heap, with predict-then-check exercises such as a = [1, 2, 3]; b = a; b.append(4); print(a). Closes the week-eight consolidation of the mutable containers and the nested-loop data-structure building.
:::
